cards.name: Vir Pedicae Mortis - the Unhallowed Warden

effects.printed_clause: If Summoned: Tribute another own monster; shuffle an opponent monster into Deck. HOPT.
effects.lua_implementation: Normal/Special triggers share HOPT, Tribute excludes handler, then non-targetingly selects and sends an opponent monster to shuffled Deck.

official_references.matched_structure: Tribute cost with MZONE release accounting.

effects.printed_clause: If used as Link Material for Vir Pedicae and sent to GY/banished: Tribute own monster; Special Summon this. HOPT.
effects.lua_implementation: EVENT_BE_MATERIAL checks exact Link reason, destination and archetype Link reason card; Tribute cost frees a zone and handler Special Summons from GY/banishment; HOPT.

official_references.matched_structure: EVENT_BE_MATERIAL trigger checks destination and reason card before recovering/summoning.

coverage_override.reason: The Summon-triggered Tribute/shuffle effect and the Link-material destination-triggered Tribute/self-Summon effect are the two distinct effects; each record includes its HOPT.
